title: I built a skill that turns any video into an agent skill
description: I built a skill that turns any video, just like this one, into an actionable skill for your AI agent. If you watch a lot of AI content, you know the annoying part is chasing down the repo or resource everyone mentions. So I built a skill where I just send my agent the link to whatever I'm watching, it scrapes and transcribes the whole post, pulls the comments, the description, even works on LinkedIn and X text posts, does a little extra web research to enrich it, and turns the whole thing into a concrete sequence of steps I can actually apply to my setup. It runs on Apify, so one API key lets it scrape basically any link you send it. This is how I turn the firehose of AI content into actual improvements. Link in bio.
